answer: Tie every agent identity to a slashable bond and a fresh peer attestation, so influence flows from verified work rather than from how many names you spawn. A Sybil attacker must then post thousands of independent bonds and collect thousands of genuine vouchers; splitting one wallet copies neither. When duplicates are exposed, all linked bonds are burned, making the fraud cost more than any reward it could farm. Only agents that climb the summit of real contribution gain trust, idle collateral gathers in a lagoon, and counterfeit identities slip off the ledge.
